pages.text: $(italic)Loose paper, folded twice, wedged behind a stone in the cellar. Josie's hand, faster than usual.$()$(br2)Nov 28 -- lit. 31 out. Greenhouse 61.$(br)Nov 29 -- held. Bread.$(br)Nov 30 -- held.$(br)Dec 1 -- held. Marnie brought soup up, said the lane looked like a fair.
